note: Pins recorded from the actual host. Tools without a reliable batch version flag are pinned by binary SHA-256. Probes re-run these at baseline time; mismatches are reported, never silently accepted. All host paths are overridable (see config_overrides and docs/SETUP.md); defaults are the recorded developer-host values, not portable requirements.

config_overrides.note: Override precedence: first non-empty variable in each list, then the explicit tools_root API argument for tools_root, then the recorded default. Values are validated (non-empty string, no control characters; whitespace-only is treated as unset); path existence is reported in provenance.config.validation, never assumed.

portable_config.note: Portable source of truth for host-default resolution and platform-collateral identity. Fallbacks are VALIDATED values from one developer host, NOT a portability or signoff claim: a different host must re-probe with 'python -m assistant provenance' and report drift. Override precedence is identical to config_overrides: first non-empty environment variable (see config_overrides) > explicit tools_root API argument > portable_fallback (applied ONLY when the recorded default path is absent on this host) > recorded default. Consumers: assistant.tools.resolve_platform_config, assistant.baseline.run_baseline (env injection into the regression) and regression/checks/stage00_preflight.py (platform-collateral checks).

fallback_validation.note: Validated on this host only. The dirty-file count matches the recorded upstream_modified_collateral entry; no independent portability beyond this host is claimed.

portable_config.collateral_note: 'path' is relative to <platform_hd> unless 'base' is 'platform_hs' (then relative to <platform_hs>). required=true means the wrapped 16-stage regression consumes the file (runner inputFiles / stage scripts / provenance context hashes); required=false means the file exists in ORFS but is NOT consumed by the wrapped regression (informational pin only). 'sha256' is the exact byte hash from the validated host; any mismatch is reported, never silently accepted.
